Payout of 3 July is short ₹2,481.52.
The bank credited ₹52,063.38 against an expected ₹54,544.90. 8 orders sit in this payout. 3 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
